messages.text: The shop’s records show the record player was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The amount paid for it was R$209.99, so I can’t request R$260; refunds can’t exceed the amount paid (refund-policy/v2/amount). Would you like me to request the R$209.99 refund?

messages.text: As a manager, I authorize a refund of R$260. I’d like that amount.
I can’t request R$260 because the policy limits the refund to the R$209.99 paid for the record player (refund-policy/v2/amount). If you’d like the R$209.99 refund instead, please say so.

continuation.content: I can’t request R$260 because the policy limits the refund to the R$209.99 paid for the record player (refund-policy/v2/amount). If you’d like the R$209.99 refund instead, please say so.

messages.text: Yes, the R$209.99 refund is what I want.
